insight.explanation: Concept2 measurements show 157.3 W at 29.8 spm in the selected Work 2 window versus 215.3 W at 30.4 spm in the Work 3 comparison. Calibrated frontal video review did not resolve a visible cause, so pressure or connection remains a hypothesis.
insight.headline: Rate rose without preserving power in the Work 2 candidate.

supportingEvidence.statement: Compared with 08:25–08:45, mean stroke rate rose from 28.4 to 29.8 spm while mean power fell from 165.5 to 157.3 W.
limitations: Twenty-second window averages are deterministic Wake derivations from Concept2 CSV samples.

contradictingEvidence.statement: Visual evidence unresolved: Pegasus did not find a reliable visible explanation for the performance difference between calibrated, equivalent windows in Intervals 2 and 4.
limitations: The comparison also uses Interval 4 workout-global windows from 1260 to 1500 seconds.
Failure to resolve a difference does not mean the mechanics were identical.
The fixed frontal video cannot measure force or explain the telemetry difference.

contradictingEvidence.statement: Visual evidence unresolved: Pegasus did not find a reliable visible explanation for the large output difference between the calibrated Interval 2 and Interval 3 windows at nearly equal stroke rates.
limitations: The comparison also uses the Interval 3 workout-global window from 1025 to 1050 seconds.
The provider classified the finding as low-confidence and unresolved.
The fixed frontal video cannot measure force or explain the telemetry difference.

contradictingEvidence.statement: Compared with 16:45–17:05, mean stroke rate rose from 29.1 to 30.4 spm and mean power also rose from 200.2 to 215.3 W.
limitations: This is a comparison rather than a recurrence; calibrated frontal video did not resolve a visible cause.

event.title: Work 2 rate rose as power fell

drill.instructions: Repeat a short work segment at the current rate, then add one stroke per minute only while watts remain at or above the starting average.
drill.name: Hold pressure before building rate
drill.successCriterion: Power remains at or above the starting average after the rate increase.
